label: Swiss National Bank data portal
terms_note: Open data (SNB terms of use: source to be cited), no key. HTML help pages; the API serves each data cube as CSV: a UTF-8 BOM, a three-line preamble (CubeId, PublishingDate, blank), then semicolon-separated long-format rows Date;D0;D1;...;Value (one row per date x dimension items, an empty Value where there is no observation). Dimension ids are listed at /api/cube/{cube}/dimensions/en. Unknown cube: 404 {"code":"404","message":"Table nopecube not found"} (live 2026-10-01).

get_series.note: series_id is '<cube>/<D0 item>/<D1 item>' for two-dimensional cubes, e.g. 'devkum/M0/EUR1' (monthly average CHF per 1 EUR), 'devkum/M1/USD1' (end of month, USD). start/end are sent as YYYY-MM. Rows without a value are left out.

not_offered.search_symbols: There is no cube search API; cube ids are listed on the portal's topic pages and dimensions at /api/cube/{cube}/dimensions/en.
